title: Epley maneuver for positional vertigo
what: The doctor turns your head and body in a set order. This moves tiny particles in the inner ear back into place, and the dizziness goes away.
why: When you feel dizzy for a few seconds when turning over in bed, bending down, or looking up.
duration: usually 10 to 15 minutes; relief often comes right away or within a few days
tell_doctor: How and when the dizziness starts
If you had a head injury
If your neck or back hurts, or if you had neck surgery
If you have heart or blood vessel disease, or high blood pressure
If you have weakness in an arm or leg, double vision, or trouble speaking

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Wear comfortable clothes without a tight collar. Your head will be turned and you will lie down.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: It is better not to come on a full stomach. You may feel sick during the maneuver.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: Bring someone with you. It is better not to drive right after the procedure.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: The doctor checks which ear is causing the dizziness
You sit on the exam table, and your head is turned to one side
You are quickly laid on your back with your head hanging slightly over the edge
Your head is slowly turned to the other side
Then you roll onto your side and look down
Each position is held for about a minute, until the dizziness settles
You are helped to sit up slowly
feel: During the maneuver, you may feel very dizzy. This is expected
After the procedure, you may feel a little unsteady for the day
after: Sit for a few minutes before you stand up
For the first day, move calmly and avoid bending over quickly
The doctor may show you exercises for home
Sometimes the maneuver is repeated at the next visit
red_flags: A severe headache, weakness in an arm or leg, or trouble speaking: call emergency services
Dizziness that lasts for hours and does not depend on head position
Severe vomiting, or you cannot stand

faq.q: Can I do the Epley maneuver myself at home?
faq.a: Sometimes the doctor teaches you to do it at home. But first you need an exam to find out which ear and what the cause is.
Sometimes it comes back after months or years. Then the maneuver can be repeated.

reminders.text: Epley maneuver soon. Bring someone with you. It is better not to drive after the procedure.
